$comment: Per-job CI timing budgets — read by scripts/ci-timings.mjs's `summarize` command. See README.md's CI section for the raise protocol (mirrors client-admin/scripts/check-route-chunks.mjs's bundle-budget rule: every raise happens in a PR that says why, citing the measured number and the ticket). Job names must match ci.yml's rendered `name:` exactly, including matrix-interpolated shard numbers — the Jobs API returns the interpolated name, not the template. A job with no entry here always reports `budget: —` and never fails, so an unlisted job (a new job, or a renamed one) degrades to 'unmeasured', not 'silently blocking'. [18.5.2] Re-baselined against real `gh run list`/Jobs API data (see below); `sweeps`/`quality` (Lighthouse) are deliberately NOT added here — zero real completed `merge_group` runs exist in the trailing-60-run window to baseline them against (every sample so far is `skipped`, since nothing has actually gone through the merge queue yet). Add them once a real `merge_group` run completes.

burnIn.$comment: Global default: warn only, never hard-fail. Issue #436's plan (Escalation 3) proposed flipping to true after 20 consecutive green runs with zero false positives, but left the exact graduation date for a human decision — deliberately not invented here. A job may set its own `enforce: true` to graduate ahead of this flag once its budget has proven stable.
